title: Door D-01 about 30 cm left of design
description: Visual check, not a survey. Seen from inside the room, the door opening in Wall W-01 South looks about 30 cm left of its modelled position.
suggested_action: Check the door position with a tape measure before the frame is fixed, then update either the model or the setting-out.
